title: fix(console): translate public form section headings and field labels (objectui#8813)
body:
Fixes #8813 — seam 2 of objectui#8408. Seam 1 shipped as objectui#8814.

## What was broken

The public form route `/f/:slug` never translated its section headings. A `zh-CN`
visitor was greeted by "Your application" — the string the author typed while
building the form — even when the app bundle carried
`objects.ats_inquiry._sections.apply.label`.

The blocker was structural, not a missing call. `buildSections` copied the
authored `sec.label` onto its renderable row and **dropped `sec.name`**, and
`RenderableSection` declared no `name` member at all. The convention key is
`{ns}.objects.{objectName}._sections.{sectionName}.label`, so with the section's
stable name gone the key could not be **constructed** at the render site,
whatever the render site did there. Carrying `sec.name` is the precondition; the
two lookups are what it enables.

## What changed

- `RenderableSection` carries `name`, and `buildSections` copies it. A
  group-REFERENCED section (`{ group: 'parties' }`) arrives here already
  resolved and carries the group's key as its name, so it translates on the same
  convention.
- The section heading resolves through
  `useSafeFieldLabel().sectionLabel(loaded.object, sec.name, sec.label)` — the
  same resolver `ObjectForm`, `ModalForm` and `record-details` use on the app
  path, so the two form renderers cannot drift apart about what the key IS.
- The field label resolves through `fieldLabel(loaded.object, f.name, f.label)`.
  On this route the served label is usually already localized by the server
  payload; the client lookup is the overlay an app bundle can put on top of it,
  not a replacement for it.
- ⛔ No `I18nProvider` was mounted. One already sits above this route
  (`main.tsx` wraps the whole `App`), measured on the real tree in #8813 with a
  four-cell control matrix. That work does not exist.
- The `sec.label` render guard is unchanged on purpose: this translates a heading
  that already renders, it does not start rendering headings for sections that
  had none.

### The page heading stays `form.title` — the PM ruling, and its premise re-measured

The ruling said route the heading nowhere, because `useObjectLabel` resolves a
view label as `objects.{object}._views.{view}.label` and this route has no view
name in hand. **The premise holds**, and the falsification condition was checked
rather than assumed:

- `PublicFormPayload` is `{ slug, object, label?, form, objectSchema }` — no
  view-name member.
- `slug` is not the view name in disguise. `PublicFormsPage` carries `name` (from
  `spec.name`) and `slug` (parsed out of `sharing.publicLink`) as two separate
  members of one row, and the slug is edited through its own "URL slug" input.

So there is no key to build, and no reopening of the ruling.

## The reverse verification — the only leg that can detect a missed lookup

Because the provider **is** mounted, `useSafeFieldLabel` returns real resolvers
and nothing throws: a green test proves the resolver RAN, not that a key was
FOUND. Both ablations were run from the committed fix, mutation proven on disk
before any result was read, restore proven after.

**Ablation 1 — remove the translation key from the bundle (the acceptance leg).**
Deleted `_sections.apply.label` from the test's `BUNDLE`.

```
  Test Files  1 failed (1)   Tests  2 failed | 4 passed (6)
```

Restore: `git hash-object` back to `c724917f...`, `git diff HEAD` empty,
`git status` clean.

**Ablation 2 — remove the `sec.name` carry (the structural blocker).**
Deleted `name: sec.name,` from `buildSections`.

```

POST anchor count: 0
POST blob: 85392f875dad78e9f978ea27e7bf2597ffdee666  (HEAD 27c0ac100db26f7198b795616dc13615fe687d8a)
ABLATION-2 vitest exit: 1
  x SECTION_HEADING_IS_TRANSLATED
  x KEY_IS_THE_SECTION_NAME_NOT_THE_LABEL
  AssertionError: expected 'Your application' to be 'the translated heading'
  Test Files  1 failed (1)   Tests  2 failed | 4 passed (6)
```

Restore: `git hash-object` back to `27c0ac10...`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

Both mutations edit source the test imports by RELATIVE path, so no build step
sits between the edit and the run — there is no `dist/` copy that could keep an
ablation green.

The assertion is on the route itself: the tree rendered is exactly the element
`App.tsx` declares for `/f/:slug`, with nothing wrapped around it that production
does not have. The bundle reaches the resolvers the way it reaches every
unwrapped consumer — `createI18n` registers its instance as react-i18next's
process-global, the mechanism pinned in
`packages/i18n/src/__tests__/useObjectLabel-identity-5564.test.tsx`. Wrapping the
route in a provider would have tested that a provider works.

## 验收备注 — the three inherited observations, judged

**All three are OUT of scope.** Each with its successor named.

1. **`resolveInternalForm` never reads `form.title`** (`/forms/:name` heads the
   page with the raw view name when the envelope carries no label). **OUT.** It
   is not the same defect: on that route the envelope label IS the correct
   heading, and the flattened-overlay `form.label` arm genuinely is reachable
   there, so the fallback chain has a different correct answer — a design
   question, not a mechanical fix. Touching it would also have put this PR's
   heading and that route's heading under one edit, which is exactly the
   conflation the seam split avoided. *Successor: none carrying it today; the
   next card on the internal form route inherits it, and it stays recorded here
   and on #8813.* Not filed as a new issue: it is already written down in two
   places a reader of this chain reaches (the #8813 body and the seam-1 PR), and
   a third copy would fragment the decision rather than schedule it.

2. **`FormSectionSpec.description` is declared and rendered nowhere** — the same
   "authored value silently dropped" shape as seam 1's defect 2, one layer down,
   inside the very `buildSections` this PR edits. **OUT**, and this one was the
   closest call. It is a *different defect class* from the one this card fixes
   (a value never rendered at all, versus a value rendered untranslated), it
   needs a rendering decision this card has no ruling for — where a section
   subtitle goes, what it does to the section header's layout, whether it is
   translated on the same convention — and honouring it would widen what the
   route draws, which the dispatch's own fence rules out. *Successor: whoever
   picks up the ADR-0049-style enforce-or-remove question for that key; it is
   declared on the app-shell authoring surface, so the decision is "render it or
   retire it", not a `FormPage` local.* Recorded, not filed, for the reason
   above — it is already carried on #8813 and now here.

3. **The `payload.form?.label` arm in `loadPublicForm`** still names a key
   `FormViewSchema` rejects, outranked by `form.title` since seam 1. **OUT** — by
   the dispatch's own condition: it is "the thing to settle **if you touch that
   chain**", and this PR does not touch that chain. The heading expression is
   byte-identical to what seam 1 left. Its only reachable shape (a flattened
   overlay from the public resolver) still cannot be exercised from this repo, so
   settling it here would be a deletion argued from absence. *Successor: the next
   card that edits `loadPublicForm`'s fallback chain.*

**One thing this PR did fix beyond the two mechanical halves**, because the diff
itself falsified it — a comment made false by my own change is my diff's problem,
not a finding:

- `FormPage.tsx` `isSectionVisible` said "Sections have no `name`". They do now.
  The comment is corrected, and the diagnostic locator deliberately still names
  the heading rather than the name: a warning is read by the person looking at
  the screen, and the wording is pinned by
  `FormPage.conditionalRules.test.tsx` (`visibleWhen of section 'Escalation'`).
- `packages/app-shell/.../form-spec.ts` said `pane` and `name` are "declared here
  even though no renderer in this repo reads them yet". `name` is read now.
  Comment-only, no behaviour; app-shell's own test suite, type-check and lint
  were run whole anyway (verdicts above).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**
公开表单页 `/f/:slug` 的分区标题和字段标签,现在会走应用的 i18n 词包翻译了。
之前 `zh-CN` 的访客看到的是作者建表单时敲的那串英文("Your application"),
哪怕词包里已经写好了对应的中文。真正卡住的不是"忘了调翻译函数",而是渲染层
拿不到构造 key 所需的那半个东西:`buildSections` 只把作者写的 `label` 抄了过去,
把分区稳定的 `name` 丢在了原地,而 key 的写法必须是
`objects.<对象>._sections.<分区名>.label`。所以这次先把 `name` 带上,再接上两个
既有的解析器 —— 和后台表单页(`ObjectForm` / `ModalForm` / 记录详情页)用的是
同一个,不是新写的第二套。

**为什么改**
这是一张真实的用户可见缺陷:它是 Console 上唯一一个匿名访客能看到的页面。
另外它有个专属的陷阱:因为 provider 本来就挂着,解析器不会抛错,所以"测试绿了"
只能证明代码跑过了,证明不了 key 被找到。这次的回归测试是按"能失败"来写的 ——
把词条从词包里删掉,它必须变红;实测确实变红(见上文两次消融的落盘哈希和输出)。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**
风险很低。作者写的字符串仍然是兜底:词包里没有的分区,标题原样保留;作者没写
`name` 的分区没有 key,也原样保留。渲染条件一个字没动,不会凭空多出标题来。
唯一的行为变化是:词包里**有**词条时,显示词条的内容 —— 那正是这张卡要的。
回滚成本 = 一个 commit,`git revert f91ab585d`,没有数据迁移、没有 API 变更、
没有已发布类型的收窄(`RenderableSection` 是 `FormPage.tsx` 内部类型)。

**席位意见**
（留白,PM 席位填）

**你要做的**
如果同意,直接合并即可(本 PR 不在受管面,走正常合并队列)。若想留意一处判断:
本 PR 明确**不动**页面大标题,理由是这条路由手里没有 view 名,把它路由到
`_views` key 上最好也是空操作;这一点按 PM 裁决执行,并且本次实测复核了前提
(payload 里确实没有 view 名,`slug` 是作者另行编辑的发布短链,不是 view 名)。
